Several [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] after the founding of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] in [[4980 BBY]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Lokess]] proposed a '''plot''' to overthrow the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] to her fellow members of the Empire's ruling [[Dark Council]]. The other Councilors agreed, but when they ascended the steps of the [[Imperial Citadel (Sith Empire)|Imperial Citadel]] to confront the Emperor, he [[Death/Legends|killed]] them all except for Lokess in a flash of light. Lokess was locked in the depths of the Citadel to be tortured until her death, and a new Dark Council was appointed.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
